title: Local embedding index and hybrid lexical-semantic-graph ranker v0
problem: Blocked by ticket-423. Lexical and graph retrieval cannot reliably match semantically related wording. Add a local-first, versioned embedding layer and deterministic rank fusion without making model downloads, cloud calls, or new services part of default verification.
acceptance_criteria: A provider-neutral embedding contract records provider, model, dimensions, normalization, content checksum, created_at, and index version for accepted-claim representations.
Default tests use a deterministic mock embedding provider and require no network, Ollama, GPU, model download, or cloud key.
An explicitly enabled local provider can incrementally embed new or changed accepted claims and invalidates stale vectors when model or content checksum changes.
Hybrid ranking fuses lexical, semantic, and graph signals with deterministic configured weights or reciprocal-rank fusion and records component scores and ranking reasons.
Lifecycle or source-eligibility changes remove or suppress ineligible items before retrieval; rejected and needs-review claims are never embedded for the accepted index.
Local embedding dependencies are optional and fail closed with a clear operator message when unavailable.
On completion, ticket-425 changes from blocked to ready; no later Phase 4 ticket is activated.
test_plan: With mock-only env and mock embeddings: python -m pytest tests/unit/test_embedding_index.py tests/unit/test_hybrid_retriever.py tests/unit/test_research_retriever.py -q
With mock-only env: python -m pytest tests/golden -q
With mock-only env: python -m rge.cli verify --skip-site
non_goals: Do not require an external vector database or hosted embedding API.
Do not download a model during default tests, verify, or execute-safe.
Do not embed raw prompts, secrets, private notes, or rejected claim text in the accepted retrieval index.
rollback_plan: Disable the semantic component and fall back to ticket-423 lexical-plus-graph retrieval. Vector rows may be discarded and rebuilt because they are derived from accepted data.
